item.title: Large cracks in road surface, 25th September
item.description:
Heading towards Seven Springs, just past the entrance to the field on the right hand side. Several large cracks have appeared in the road surface. Throughout this summer they have become more pronounced and more unsafe. The surface of the road is now extremely uneven and causes vehicles to bounce violently as they travel over the surface. This stretch of road also becomes waterlogged in heavy rain - which further increases the danger posed by these cracks. Although temporary traffic lights have been set up either side of the dangerous stretch, there's no detail here to say when repairs/a fix will take place.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cheltenham Road, Colesbourne, Cotswold

item.title: Road surface has dropped / cracked, 25th September
item.description:
Road surface has dropped/cracked - causing a very uneven and unsafe road surface. Heading south down the hill towards Cheltenham on the A40. The large crack in the road is directly on the line of the vehicle wheels. The crack is not particularly visible until you are almost on top of it - so there is a risk of sudden braking as well as risks posed by the sudden change in road surface. It is a significant change in the surface which can cause steering difficult. The crack has been there all summer. As we head into winter, this will become increasingly unsafe as this is already a dangerous bend; and since the tree felling on the steep bank, the road now suffers from excessive water run-off from the steep bank to one side. Potential risks include loss of control due to the uneven road surface, compounded by the slippery surface due to water or ice, and decreased visibility in the dark. This problem appears to have been reported before, but it is not yet repaired or fixed.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): A40, Cotswold
